title: The fresh sealed set for the lead agent's final test: twelve people written by an independent writer shown the tables, registered and pinned
request: The owner asked to write the people of the sealed set now, after the writing rule was fixed (the stories must fit their tables).
spec: Twelve new people, written by a writer who has not seen the lead agent's behaviour or any result, for the three invented tables; hard kinds first; every table-sharing person carries claims that code accepts; the set is pinned by fingerprint before its one run.
plan: Brief an independent writer with the generated brief, the tables and the record format only
Check the set by code and by structure, never by reading its stories
Have the writer fix the one story that contradicted the way the exam shares a table
Register the split, pin its fingerprint, test, review, commit

decisions.decision: A separate subagent wrote the people, told not to read results, earlier sealed sets, the agent's code, the rubric or any conversation
decisions.why: the final test is run once; a writer who knew how the agent behaves could write people that suit it or trap it

decisions.decision: The orchestrating session checked the set by counts and by code and did not read the stories
decisions.why: whoever then tunes the agent should not have read the sealed people

decisions.decision: The set is read against gate v4: v3's thresholds, and the owner's labelled papers are counted
decisions.why: the plan said the checks of the second sealed gate; the review found that its owner_labels was read by nothing, so a single labelled paper could carry a verdict read once

decisions.decision: No person was written to ask for rows
decisions.why: twelve people left no room for it after three advice, three clear requests and the six traps the brief lists

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation_exam/people_sealed_v3.json and .sha256; __init__.py (SPLITS, SEALED, SEALED_ARMS, help); gate.py (GATES); tests/test_conversation_exam_sealed_v3.py; gate.py (GATE_V4 with enforce_count, verdict takes labelled=); tests/test_conversation_exam_sealed_v3.py (LabelCountTests)

findings.defect: One draft story said the table it shares had not been sent yet
findings.scenario: the exam attaches the table to the person's first message, so a person who believes it is not sent says so and the conversation drifts into upload trouble, as r-17 and r-20 did
findings.cause: the writer's story and the way the exam shares a table disagreed, which the claims check cannot see because it compares data, not the account of sharing
findings.fix: the same writer rewrote that story; a scan of every table-sharing person for wording about unsent, wrong or later files found no other
findings.test: tests/test_conversation_exam_sealed_v3.py test_every_person_passes_the_checks_and_every_table_story_carries_claims (claims), the scan itself is not a test

findings.defect: The number of papers the owner must label was never enforced by the gate
findings.scenario: the final verdict takes an agreement number and compares it with its bar; one labelled paper out of twelve could give an agreement of one and pass the check
findings.cause: owner_labels was a field of the gate that no code read; verdict() took only the number
findings.fix: gate v4 (the set's gate) counts the papers: a bare agreement is refused, and fewer than the needed number leaves the verdict waiting; the gates of the sets already run are unchanged

findings.defect: The paired options test may not run on a set with few people who get options from both students
findings.scenario: the test that the lead agent's options beat Claude alone's runs only when enough people have options from both; with three advice people and a dozen in all it may not, as in the ten-person route test, leaving the absolute bar as the only option check
findings.cause: the rule is the gate's own from the first sealed set: where both students showed options to enough of the same people, the paired gain must hold
findings.fix: none: it is the gate's stated rule and keeps the set comparable with the second sealed set; the owner is told what the gate does not measure

measurements.name: the sealed set's structure against the brief's minimums
measurements.gate: twelve people, hard kinds first, at least three advice people with no table and three clear requests on a table that holds them, all six named traps present, every level and style used, openings distinct, every person passing the checker with claims required
measurements.result: twelve people in the order advice (three), clear requests (three), then prediction, business and preparation people; routes: advice 3, prediction 4, preparation 2, analysis 1, reporting 1, business 1; traps: clear request 3, each other named trap 1; levels 4, 4, 4; every table-sharing person carries claims; the plan for both students estimates EUR 2.52, more once the advice people are counted
limits: a trap kind with one person is decided by that person
the stories were not read by the session that will run the set

outcome: The set is written, pinned and registered; nothing is run. Its one run needs the owner's go on the price and the owner's labels afterwards.
lessons: Brief an independent writer with the real data and the checks, not with the agent
Check a sealed set by structure and by code, so that nobody who tunes the agent has read it
risks: The gate is the second sealed set's, set for twenty people; its checks on twelve people are read in the review
A trap kind with one person has no rate worth the name
The paired options test may be skipped on twelve people; a trap kind with one person is decided by that person; both are the owner's to accept before the run
